name: Screecher Spirits
summary: In Steamwheedle Port, Yeh'kinya asks you to gather the spirits of Feralas vale screechers. They are kin to an ancient god, and he promises to tell you more when you bring back three essences.

sections.title: Spirits of Feralas
sections.body: Yeh'kinya says the vale screechers of Feralas are kin to an ancient god. Their spirits are linked to him. He gives you a bramble wand and sends you to southern and central Feralas. Wave it over a fallen vale screecher to draw out its spirit, then touch the spirit to gather its essence. He wants three essences returned with the bramble.

sections.title: What Yeh'kinya Shares
sections.body: Yeh'kinya names the old god as Hakkar the Soulflayer. An ancient troll prophecy foretells the dead god's return to the world. Some expect his return to bring the trolls glory and joy; others fear it will end everything. Yeh'kinya puts no faith in the myth, but knows Hakkar's essence is powerful and should stay out of the wrong hands.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where are they?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya asks you in Steamwheedle Port.
Vale screechers live in southern and central Feralas.

faq.q: How do you capture the screecher spirits?
faq.answer: Wave Yeh'kinya's bramble wand over a fallen vale screecher to draw out its spirit. Then touch the spirit to gather its essence.

faq.q: Why does Yeh'kinya want screecher spirits?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya says the vale screechers are kin to an ancient god, and their spirits are linked to him. He promises to tell you more about the god when you return.
